text: I think you'll really enjoy this Thai Chicken With Basil and Coconut Milk recipe. As someone who likes chicken and is looking for higher protein options, this dish fits the bill with 26 grams of protein per serving. The coconut milk adds a rich and creamy texture, while the fresh basil and chilies provide a burst of flavor. The best part is that it's quick to make, ready in just 30 minutes, which fits within your 45-minute time budget. Plus, it's gluten-free, so you don't have to worry about any dietary restrictions.
